items.title: EIP-8141：加入二维 nonce
items.note: （nerolation）提交：新增 nonce_key，由 (nonce_key, nonce) 选择发送者的某条 nonce 序列，批准支付时递增对应序列，并按 SSTORE 定价收取 nonce_key 成本（0、5000 或 22100）。
items.note_en: (nerolation), submitted: adds nonce_key so (nonce_key, nonce) selects one of the sender's nonce sequences, increments that sequence on payment approval and charges a nonce_key cost at SSTORE pricing (0, 5000 or 22100).

items.title: 新增 EIP：智能账户通用中继架构
items.note: （seansing）提交：定义 relayer_* JSON-RPC 命名空间，覆盖费用发现、交易提交（含多链）与能力查询，支持无 gas 与代币付费交易；该 PR 后改到 ERC 仓库。
items.title_en: Add EIP: Generic Relayer Architecture for Smart Accounts
items.note_en: (seansing), submitted: defines a relayer_* JSON-RPC namespace for fee discovery, transaction submission (including multichain) and capability queries, supporting gasless and token fee transactions; the PR later moved to the ERCs repo.

summary_en: An EIP-8081 update merged, formally listing EIP-8141 as CFI for Hegotá and EIP-7716 and EIP-8205 as PFI. nerolation submitted a change adding 2D nonces to EIP-8141, and derekchiang's mempool factory relaxation merged. seansing proposed a generic relayer architecture for smart accounts with a relayer_* RPC namespace.
